description: HELD-OUT invention-lifecycle problems (LifecycleProblem shape) for true-generalization measurement. GENERATED + seeded (deterministic). Never train or tune against it.

problems.problem: My travel cup keeps sliding around on my sloped drafting table. I want a 3D-printable way to stop it from sliding off without clamping anything to the surface or leaving adhesive residue.
A tangle of three charger cables hangs behind my monitor and slips down behind the desk. I need a 3D-printable way to gather and route them up to the desktop with no screws or adhesive.
I follow recipes and guides on a tablet at my kitchen counter and want it held at a readable angle, raised off the surface so spills run under it, and wipeable -- 3D-printable with no hardware.
My mechanical keyboard creeps across the desk while I type. I want a 3D-printable way to keep it from sliding that grips the desk without screws and leaves no residue when removed.
I need somewhere to air-dry freshly washed 3D-printed parts on my desk so they don't touch each other or the surface, drips are caught, and it folds flat when not in use -- 3D-printable, no hardware.
My screwdriver bits roll around loose in a drawer and I can never find the size I want. I want a 3D-printable desk organizer that holds them upright, sorted by size, with no hardware.
